lastCompletedStory.title: Real-tmux integration test proving deterministic worker-pane geometry on recreate

nextStoryContext: Both stories in this PRD are now passes:true. US-001 fixed the production openPaneInSession to target orchPaneId explicitly with -l 60%. US-002 proved it with a real-tmux oracle: worker_width >= orch_width - 1 and worker_width > dash_width + 5, confirming the worker was born from the orchestrator column regardless of the active pane. No further stories remain in this PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: display-message -p -t <paneId> '#{pane_width};#{pane_height};#{pane_left};#{pane_top}' confirmed against real tmux 3.6a: returns semicolon-separated integer values (e.g. '120;30;0;0'). pane_width, pane_height, pane_left, pane_top are valid tmux format variables. Split-window geometry correctly uses these to assert worker column inheritance.
